description: 1KOMMA5° is a one-stop solution for rooftop solar, battery storage, EV charging, and heat pumps, building Europe's largest fleet of decentralized energy assets.
Aeroseal seals leaky HVAC and building envelopes with a chewing-gum-like material plus AI and IoT hardware that could cut 1.4% of global CO2 emissions.
Ampd Energy's battery storage systems replace diesel generators on construction sites, enabling cleaner, quieter, safer operations at lower cost.
AtmosZero built the world's first modular, electrified steam-generating heat pump, a direct, cost-effective replacement for gas boilers in industry.
Biomason uses microorganisms to grow concrete and cement, cutting up to 95% of CO2e emissions versus traditional Portland cement.
Blue Frontier's smart HVAC system cuts cooling energy use by up to 90%, using integrated energy storage to deliver comfort and healthier indoor air.
CarbonCure's retrofit technology lets concrete producers cut their carbon footprint by injecting captured CO₂ into mixers, where it mineralizes permanently.
Cocoon turns waste steel slag into a low-cost, low-carbon, high-performance cement replacement, easing global shortages of cementitious materials.

Ember drives a modal shift away from single-occupancy cars while electrifying the highest-mileage vehicles on the road: intercity buses.

description: Getmobil cuts e-waste by bringing circularity to consumer electronics in Turkey, connecting consumers, merchants, and trade-in partners for refurbished devices.
Gigaton uses AI to autonomously control and decarbonize energy-intensive plants, starting with cement, replacing legacy systems to cut emissions and costs.
Exited
Kelvin cuts energy waste in legacy buildings with retrofittable insulated radiator covers, heat pumps, and smart controls that lower heating costs.
Exited
LuxWall's next-generation vacuum-insulated glass cuts heating and cooling costs by up to 45% in a scalable, drop-in solution with leading performance.
Metycle decarbonizes the metals industry by enabling circular trade of scrap and recycled metals through a faster, cheaper, more efficient B2B marketplace.
Mission Zero Technologies' Direct Air Capture systems recover high-purity CO₂ from ambient air at far lower cost and energy use, ready to plug in at any site.
Molg enables circular manufacturing: robotic microfactories autonomously disassemble complex electronics, and it helps manufacturers design products for reuse.
Nabr is a direct-to-consumer housing company delivering customizable, sustainable apartments at scale, helping more people own quality homes in cities.
NatureMetrics tackles biodiversity measurement by applying low-cost genomic sequencing and easy field sampling of environmental DNA (eDNA).
Nodes & Links offers an AI-powered project control platform that turns scheduling data into insights, helping deliver complex projects on time and on budget.
Exited
OpenSolar gives thousands of solar contractors free, class-leading software to design, sell, finance, and manage solar projects end to end.
Photara builds advanced tools to replace silver with copper in solar manufacturing.
SiTration enables a circular economy with ultra-efficient, low-cost recovery of critical metals from mining waste and end-of-life batteries.
Superlight's design enables the unlock of cheaper and lighter electric trucks via a completely novel chassis and motor configuration.
Exited
Vammo electrifies urban mobility in Brazil with e-motorbike leasing and battery swapping, bundling rental, insurance, maintenance, and unlimited swaps.
